Chapter 792: Chapter 12: The Fifth Physical Body Divine Ability (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 792: Chapter 12: The Fifth Physical Body Divine Ability (Please Subscribe) “`

The Physical Body Divine Ability originates from the depths of the bloodline.

When Lin Yuan arrived in the Central Divine China World, he integrated the essence of Body Cultivation into Martial Tao.

And thus possessed a certain ability.

Normally speaking, the thicker the foundation of the physical body, the higher the rank of the Physical Body Divine Ability that would be born.

For example, in the World of Gods, Lin Yuan’s body possessed the bloodline of the Dragon Clan....

Ultimately, the Physical Body Divine Ability that was born was the ‘Elemental Body’, capable of being immune to ninety percent of the attacks at the same level in terms of rules.

And speaking of a profound foundation, none of Lin Yuan’s nine traverses compared to the present.

The inexhaustible Origin Source of the Heaven Tilt Martial World took more than a hundred thousand years to gestate into form, and then nurtured the Martial Ancestor Golden Body for another hundred thousand years.

But in terms of foundation, Lin Yuan even felt he wasn’t far behind those unique and special beings of the Main Universe.

A body such as this, once excavated through the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, what rank would the condensed Physical Body Divine Ability be? “There shouldn’t be a problem.”

Lin Yuan examined himself, and to facilitate his descent, this Martial Ancestor Golden Body was also a flesh and blood body, meeting all the prerequisites for condensing a Physical Body Divine Ability. “Let’s start cultivating.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts converged, and his mind sank into immersion.

In his past nine traverses, if Lin Yuan wanted to cultivate, to recover his strength, he would inevitably need a large amount of external resources.

There was no shackles to his realm, but the accumulation of energy was also a must.

But now?

This Martial Ancestor Golden Body itself contained energy that could be called the energy of an entire world; otherwise, Lin Yuan could not have easily suppressed those two Foreign Evil Gods.

And as the ‘Heavens’ Will’ of Tianqing World, with a single thought, Lin Yuan could use everything in Tianqing World for himself.

Therefore.

The Lin Yuan who fell into cultivation at this moment did not have any delay at all.

Just one breath.

He had entered the threshold of the First Rank Martial Tao.

Ten breaths, Second Layer Martial Tao.

Fifty breaths, Martial Tao Third Rank.

Half an incense stick, Fourth Stage Martial Tao.

One incense stick, Martial Tao Fifth Stage.

Half an hour, Sixth Stage Martial Tao.

And at the Sixth Stage Martial Tao, one begins to unlock the power deep within the bloodline, which is also the stage of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path where a Physical Body Divine Ability is born. “Hmm?”

Lin Yuan carefully felt his own body, vaguely sensing that a certain power in the depths of his body was beginning to coalesce and sublimate. “I can feel it, this body’s condensed Physical Body Divine Ability will definitely surpass the previous four types.”

A sense of expectation faintly emerged in Lin Yuan’s heart.

So far.

Lin Yuan possessed a total of four Physical Body Divine Abilities.

They were—

Blood Rebirth.

Mountain Moving.

Strengthening.

Elemental Body.

Through past experiences of condensing Physical Body Divine Abilities, Lin Yuan felt that the Divine Ability his body was condensing this time would definitely be extraordinary.

Of course, it is hard to say there is a true hierarchy among Physical Body Divine Abilities; they yield different effects under different circumstances.

But the imprint aura that is coalescing in Lin Yuan’s body has a sense of supremacy over the previous four Physical Body Divine Abilities. “At this rate, to completely form the imprint of the Divine Ability deep within the body, it might take several years or even decades.”

Lin Yuan pondered within his heart but soon shook his head.

That would be the normal situation, which is the time that a regular Martial Arts Evolutionary would need to reach Sixth Rank during cultivation.

But Lin Yuan is not a regular Martial Arts Evolutionary; he is the Ancestor of Martial Arts, and having undergone nine cycles of rebirth and reconstruction, along with the minutiae manipulation of the physical body from the Main Universe,

Lin Yuan can completely accelerate the speed of the Divine Ability Imprint’s formation without any hidden dangers, thus allowing the Physical Body Divine Ability to condense earlier. “About three to four days,” Lin Yuan estimated. That is to say, in three to four days, the Divine Ability Imprint deep in his body would be completely condensed. “Continue to cultivate.”

While Lin Yuan focused on the rapid coalescing of the Divine Ability Imprint deep within, he continued to cultivate. Now, he was only at Sixth Stage Martial Tao, still some distance from his prime strength.

As for not cultivating during the process of condensing the Physical Body Divine Ability, to avoid interference with the formation? If it were during his initial condensation of a Physical Body Divine Ability, Lin Yuan might have been concerned about this aspect.

But now… Lin Yuan naturally didn’t need to consider this.

There was no helping it; Lin Yuan’s realm was too high, and his control over the microscopic domains of his body was too strong.

Many taboos related to cultivation, in Lin Yuan’s eyes, seemed as if they did not exist at all. …

Outside the Martial Hall.

The High Priest Qingyao stood before a group of powerful beings from the Tianqing World. “High Priest, are you saying that those two invading Evil Gods were suppressed by the arrival of the Martial Ancestor?” an old man with white hair asked in disbelief.

They, too, had seen the battle that had just taken place, where the two Foreign Evil Gods vanished like ants.

But they had not determined who the existence that had made the move was.

Now, after the High Priest’s explanation, one can imagine the shock in their hearts.

Martial Ancestor.

The legendary Martial Ancestor has descended? “What else could it be?” “Besides the Martial Ancestor, who else could possess such means? Who else would protect us all?” “`

The High Priest Qingyao spoke slowly, barely having fully recovered from the shock of the Martial Ancestor’s action even now.

First, the Martial Ancestor, who had been worshiped by the beings of the Tianqing World for hundreds of thousands of years, had actually appeared.

Second, the Martial Ancestor was too powerful, so powerful that the two Foreign Evil Gods which could almost destroy the world seemed like a joke in comparison. “The Martial Ancestor is merciful,” proclaimed the white-haired old man, believing it immediately.

He discreetly glanced towards the great doors of the Martial Hall, his eyes glowing with deep reverence.

It was not just him, the other Martial Dao Cultivators on the scene felt the same.

Because they all subtly sensed that, as they gazed into the depths of the Martial Hall, their own cultivation in the Martial Path trembled with a sensation of reverence and worship.

As if they had laid eyes on the ultimate source of all Martial Paths in the world.

This feeling had never occurred, even when faced with the Martial Ancestor Golden Body.

Therefore, with just a brief explanation from the High Priest, there was no question in the minds of everyone present. “The Martial Ancestor needs to go into seclusion for a while.” “During this time, unless it’s a significant matter, there’s no need to disturb the Martial Ancestor,” said High Priest Qingyao immediately. “Yes,” replied the numerous Martial Dao Cultivators with utmost respect, ready to guard the entrance of the Martial Hall with utmost diligence, ensuring that the Martial Ancestor’s seclusion would be undisturbed. …

In the depths of the Boundless Void, in front of a massive secret realm floating in the void, a towering figure sat cross-legged.

This towering figure, a monster with eighteen arms, emitted a lunatic and strange aura that spread into all directions.

This imposing silhouette was none other than the Black Demon Pavilion’s Master, a formidable being that instilled terror among the Foreign Evil Gods. “I have been contemplating this treasure for hundreds of thousands of years, yet I still feel so far from truly comprehending it,” the Black Demon Pavilion Master frowned, staring at a ‘map’ in front of him.

Nearly two hundred thousand years ago, he acquired this treasure from the secret realm before him and had been continuously contemplating it ever since.

It was through contemplating this ‘map’ that the Black Demon Pavilion Master’s strength made significant leaps, eventually making him one of the most potent Evil Gods in the region, establishing the Black Demon Pavilion, and commanding a vast number of Foreign Evil Gods.

But even with his current strength and status, the Black Demon Pavilion Master was still somewhat dissatisfied because he sensed a great secret within the ‘map’ before him, and no matter what, he just couldn’t fully grasp it. “Could this treasure be related to the legendary Ninth Stage Evil Gods?” the Black Demon Pavilion Master wondered.

The growth of Foreign Evil Gods is divided into nine stages.

The Ninth Stage is legendary, and an Evil God that grows to this stage is said to be the dominion over all Foreign Evil Gods. Their power can sweep across the vast and boundless void.

For now, the Black Demon Pavilion Master is only an Eighth Stage Evil God.

While only one stage separates him from the Ninth Stage, the more he practiced and grew, the more the Black Demon Pavilion Master realized how distant the Ninth Stage was.

The Black Demon Pavilion Master had a faint feeling that the gap between the Eighth and Ninth Stages was far larger than all the gaps from the First to the Eighth Stage combined and by a large margin at that.

As the Black Demon Pavilion Master continued his contemplation of the ‘map’ before him, suddenly— his expression changed. “The ‘Demonic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ I sent out were suppressed?”

Being in command of a large number of subordinates, the Black Demon Pavilion Master was naturally the first to know everything that transpired outside the Tianqing World. “I knew that there was a great secret within that world. In just a few hundred thousand years, it had surged its world origin by tenfold; it seems it’s really so,” the Black Demon Pavilion Master’s eyes flickered with a hint of red.

Most of his energy and time were spent contemplating the ‘map’ in front of him, which was why he had the ‘Demonic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ take over the Tianqing World. “It seems I need to make a trip there myself.”

The Black Demon Pavilion Master carefully put away the ‘map,’ then slowly rose to his feet. “Considering that the existence inside that world could easily deal with the ‘Demonic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream,’ it must be no simple place. With my power alone, I’m not fully confident about taking it down completely.”

Thinking this, the Black Demon Pavilion Master immediately started contacting some friends.

While true friendship doesn’t exist among the Foreign Evil Gods, they occasionally cooperate with each other for mutual benefits.

The friends that the Black Demon Pavilion Master called upon were also among the most powerful Evil Gods in the region, with strength at the same level as his own.

In the eyes of the Black Demon Pavilion Master, with his power alone, there was no certainty in facing the entity within the Tianqing World that suppressed the ‘Demonic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream.’

But with the help of several friends, it would undoubtedly be foolproof. …

Back in the Tianqing World, inside the Martial Hall, time swiftly passed by three or four days.

In these three or four days, Lin Yuan had successfully recovered to the Tenth Stage Martial Tao.

There was no way around it; in the Tianqing World, Lin Yuan’s advantages were too great. Recovering strength was merely a matter of accumulating energy, nothing could be more straightforward.

Not to mention anything else, just the infinite world origin contained within the Martial Ancestor Golden Body was enough to allow Lin Yuan to rapidly cultivate from the First to the Ninth Rank Peak.

The stretch from the Ninth Rank Peak to the Tenth Rank took just a little half a day for Lin Yuan. …

Recovering to the Tenth Rank Martial Tao strength hadn’t surprised Lin Yuan.

For him, returning to the Tenth Rank Martial Tao was a matter of course.

Even if he had descended into worlds other than Tianqing World, recovering to the Tenth Rank Martial Tao would have been just a matter of time.

What Lin Yuan was truly looking forward to was that, after these three or four days of nurturing, the Divine Ability Imprint deep within his body had finally taken shape.

Lin Yuan’s fifth Physical Body Divine Ability was about to emerge. “I wonder what aspect this newly condensed Physical Body Divine Ability will entail?”

Lin Yuan ceased his cultivation, focusing intently on the subtle changes deep within his body.
